old_value: {"id":"vouch-s9w2.13","title":"trqp tests: schema oracle never checks format (date-time, uri)","description":"tests/trqp/conftest.py:181-185. check() builds Draft202012Validator(envelope) and Draft202012Validator({'$ref': ...}, registry=...) with no format_checker. jsonschema treats 'format' as annotation-only by default, so issuedAt, expiresAt (trust-task.schema.json:122,127), time_evaluated and time_requested (payload.schema.json:30-31), the error payload's date-time (trust-task-error payload.schema.json:72) and the 'uri' members are never checked.
